Nua Dhusara
(IET 18395) (Pure line selection of Dhusra)

Product Profile
Nua Dhusara is a long-duration, short-grained aromatic variety released in 2008, primarily cultivated in Odisha. With a maturity period of about 145 days, It has a yield potential of 3.5 ton per hectare. This variety exhibits moderate tolerance to various diseases and pests including sheath blight, BLB, leaf blast, sheath rot, stem borer, and gall midge-5. Notably, it performs well under organic nutrient management practices. Due to its exceptional quality attributes, Nua Dhusara holds promise for commercialization as a premium-quality rice.

- Moderately resistant to sheath rot, sheath blight, and neck blast
- High elongation ratio (2.05), Soft GC (62mm)
